text:
alisa: Quick mid-quarter capacity check — focusing on zone failover readiness after last week's kernel patch. Can each region confirm headroom and any network anomalies? Agenda: EU, US-West, APAC.
infra-bot: Autoscaler summary: overall spare GPU hours = 14.2%. Predicted 7d burn = 58,000 GPUh. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.example/capacity/summary
matt: US-West snapshot: cluster-w1 spare 8%, cluster-w2 spare 18%. w1 has 1 node draining for kernel-rollout (ETA ~2h). Spot churn up — seeing more preempts at scale. Recommend hold on noncritical evictions.
diane: EU update: eu-central spare ~22% but we saw sustained retransmits on switch-3 between racks 3/4. Ops ticket INC-4521 filed. Packet drops led to retries on a subset of async jobs, not user-facing yet.
ravi: APAC: ap-southeast peak window (09-13 UTC) down to ~3% spare. Last night had a ~10m egress throttle to GCP that caused retries. I'm temporarily adding +2 reserved GPUs for 72h to buy runway.
cheng: Ran a quick forecast with marketing campaign uplift: expected +28% GPUh WoW. If we don't add capacity, tail lat for chat workloads could breach 350ms during peak.
matt: Cost context: Spot mix in US-West ~31% currently. With higher churn, effective headroom < reported. Options: (1) bump reserved commit, (2) enable cross-region fallback for non-PII infers, (3) move some batch to off-peak quantized instances.
alisa: Can someone paste the node drain list and timelines? Also confirm failover path for EU switch issues — route to eu-west ok as fallback?
diane: ```
Drains:
- w1-node-19 (kernel patch, ETA ~2h)
- eu-node-04 (drain started, migrating KV cache)
Network:
- switch-3: high retransmits -> ticket INC-4521 (routing team triaging)
```
ravi: Updated autoscaler policy for ap-southeast: reduced scale_down_aggressiveness and added 2 reserved GPUs. Will monitor for the next 24-72h and revert if stability improves.
infra-bot: Forecast snapshot (7d window): US-West spare 9%, EU spare 20%, APAC spare 5%. Predicted burn: 74,300 GPUh. Link: https://dash.redwood.example/capacity/2155551234
cheng: Action items: (1) Matt — enable cross-region fallback for non-PII traffic by EOD. (2) Ravi — keep +2 reserved for 72h. (3) Diane — follow up on INC-4521 and confirm reroute readiness. (4) Alisa — update runbook with failover path and post to #eng-oncall.
alisa: :thumbsup: I'll take the runbook and coordinate with routing. If APAC stays below 6% spare after 12h, we'll start the promotional throttling plan (non-blocking experiments only).
matt: On it, enabling fallback and will post the config diff to the channel when done.
diane: Ack, I'll ping routing and update INC-4521 with the fallback test steps.
ravi: Monitoring dashboards and alerts set. Will report back on any further egress blips.
alisa: Thanks all — we'll reconvene if any of the headroom numbers drop further.
